prompt: Photorealistic product rendering, side view, on plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product-shot lighting. Compact four-wheel digging robot, chest-high max and about 1050 mm long overall, shown with one standing adult person beside it for true size reading as the only scale extra. Device sits on a small patch of loose soil bed cut off cleanly at the backdrop, with a collection bin at the rear. Front narrow steel trenching chain oriented vertically, engaged downward in a thin slot in the soil with small side spoil rows. Center inclined steel bucket ladder rising from front dig point with its upper head sprocket terminating immediately above and just inside the hopper throat, joined by a short enclosed gravity chute with no air gap, buckets tipping directly into hopper, ladder top capped just above hopper lip. One single mid-rear smooth steel steep wedge hopper tilted up at the rear pivot, one container only, heaped with soil. Twin aluminium tube chassis as continuous low frame with steep wedge hopper pivot-bolted directly on top of it with metal-on-metal contact, no visible gap, low between four rigid steel grouser wheels, folding aluminium arms tucked directly behind side frame mostly occluded in side view with only two wheels prominent. One single visible rear steel screw discharge chute at hopper rear pouring continuous soil stream down into bin, one screw unit only. Lithium phosphate battery pack housed low inside chassis frame, allowed to be hidden in exterior side view. Small onboard cameras on slender vertical masts bolted to chassis and standing above it over dig point and frame, mast-height air gap intentional. Real materials: brushed aluminium frame, dark steel wheels and chains, smooth painted steel hopper. Show operating moment of discharge while digging edge remains at soil: soil in slot, soil on ladder buckets tipping into hopper, soil heaped in hopper, soil stream falling into bin. Draw thin leader-line callouts on small light tags placed in empty space for Inclined Bucket Ladder, Narrow Kerf Chain, Steep Wedge Hopper, Tilt Screw Discharge, Twin Tube Chassis, Rigid Grouser Wheels, Onboard Guide Cameras, clean and legible, and no other text in image.

extra people, tools, clutter or second machines
ladder ending in mid-air with gap to hopper
gaps between chassis and hopper or hopper and screw
diagram colors, circles, arrows or sketch styling
changes_from_previous: Fixed main fault ladder->hopper disconnect: ladder head now terminates immediately above and inside hopper throat with enclosed chute, no air gap, restoring kerf->ladder->hopper path. Scale fixed: previous span ~2081x1881mm scaled by person ~2x too large; capped ladder top just above hopper lip for chest-high max and overall length ~1050mm compact. chassis: was read as apart from hopper due to pivot shadow, now direct pivot-bolted metal-on-metal contact. arm: was occluded in side view, now stated as tucked behind frame acceptable. kerf: was vertical correct for trenching, now stated as oriented vertically downward. hopper: was 1 heaped hopper over-segmented as 5, now one single container only. auger: was one screw chute fragmented as 6, now one single screw unit only. battery: was hidden inside chassis, now explicitly allowed hidden. camera: mast offset air gap is intentional, now stated as masts bolted to chassis standing above it.

visual_plan.view: True side view, entire 1050mm machine plus soil patch, bin and scale person in frame, product-shot lighting.
visual_plan.spatial_layout: Side profile front to rear: vertical kerf chain at front ground slot, inclined ladder rising front-low to mid-high ending inside hopper throat, low twin-tube chassis mid with two grouser wheels fore-aft, single wedge hopper mid-rear on chassis top, screw chute at hopper rear over bin, camera masts above front and center, small soil patch under wheels and slot cut off at backdrop, person standing clear beside for scale.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Simultaneous digging and rear discharge: front chain in soil slot, buckets loaded mid-ladder and tipping into hopper, hopper tilted up, screw pouring stream into rear bin.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Load: narrow kerf slot -> side spoil -> inclined bucket ladder -> enclosed gravity chute -> steep wedge hopper -> rear tilt screw -> bin. Signal: downward dig camera and mast cameras -> onboard encoder -> wireless link to sealed station operator.
visual_plan.interactions: Kerf cuts vertical slot leaving side spoil rows feeding ladder pickup; ladder buckets carry soil up and tip through enclosed chute directly into hopper throat; hopper pivot-bolted to chassis tilts at rear pivot; rear screw meters soil stream into bin; chassis carries ladder and hopper and transfers load to grouser wheels on soil; mast cameras overlook dig point and bin.
avoid: towering oversize ladder and wide soil bed breaking compact size
floating ladder discharge and separate hopper
